meta.name: UseMoney Architecture Map
meta.purpose: Machine-readable architecture map for AI agents working on this codebase. Read this BEFORE exploring with grep/find - it will tell you where almost everything lives. Verify with the actual file system before recommending paths the user will act on (files may have moved).

project.name: UseMoney
project.description: AI-powered trading portfolio management platform for Indian stock markets. Multi-broker integration, portfolio analytics, paper trading, FIRE planning, AI research, portfolio roast.

techStack.database: MongoDB Atlas via Prisma ORM (DigitalOcean Mongo in dev/QA - no Atlas Search)
techStack.cache: Redis (DigitalOcean) with 3-layer cache (L1 in-memory · L2 Redis · L3 SWR)
techStack.auth: Clerk (plus HMAC-signed cookie for demo mode)
techStack.ai: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro + 2.5 Flash via Vercel AI Gateway
techStack.queue: Google Cloud Pub/Sub (57 topics + dead-letter, suffix -qa/-prod)
techStack.observability: Datadog APM (Cloud Run only) + RUM + Logs + Metrics + PostHog
techStack.deployment: Vercel (web, admin, content) + GCP Cloud Run (workers, apps/api)

request: Browser/Mobile → Vercel Edge → Clerk auth → apps/web (Next.js)
apps/web → Pub/Sub (publish) → workers (Cloud Run) → process job → DB
Mobile client → apps/api (Hono, Cloud Run) → @usemoney/services → DB
topology.writePath: Components and routes NEVER call Prisma directly. The chain is: Component → Server Action (apps/web/lib/actions/*) → Service (packages/services/*.service.ts) → Prisma. The api app mirrors this for the mobile client at apps/api/src/routes/v1/*.
topology.asyncPath: Long-running jobs (broker sync, CSV import, pairing, roast, research, embedding, fund composition) publish to Pub/Sub. Workers consume via push subscriptions with OIDC auth and update BackgroundJob/SyncLog for progress polling.

web.purpose: Main product surface - dashboard, holdings, tradebook, paper, FIRE, AI chat, roast, risk, discover, learning, settings.

keyDirs.app/: Routes (66 page.tsx + 35 route.ts).MONEY-1204 (P14) added three routes under /discover: `ipo` (UpcomingIpo, tabbed upcoming/current/recently-listed, with 'current' decided on the IST calendar day — a UTC boundary would drop a closing IPO ~5.5h early); `circulars` (NseCircular by department; circNumber is NOT unique because NSE re-issues one circular per department, so the read keys on the model's own unique, and the SURV symbol match is a labelled string heuristic); and `indices/[slug]` (decision D2 — the first index-detail route: constituents + weightage, membership history from IndexMembership's open interval, IndexClose sparkline; pe/pb/divYield are NULLABLE and null means NOT REPORTED, since a volatility index has no basket to value). All three sit under the existing `/discover(.*)` matcher in proxy-routes.ts, so no gating change was needed — verified, not assumed.
keyDirs.lib/services/: Web-only helpers - most domain logic lives in packages/services.
keyDirs.lib/chat/: Message parsing + slash commands + research blocks.

api.purpose: Standalone REST + tRPC API for the mobile client.

keyDirs.src/routes/v1/: 38 domain route families (mobile-parity, MONEY-1062 / MONEY-402): dashboard, holdings, positions, trades, paired, paper, fire, mutualfunds, watchlists, notifications, research, risk, tax, subscription, brokers, jobs, market (delayed, delayed:true flag), discover, me, roast, documents, learning, credits, chat-history, quizzes, feedback, alerts, consent, imports, compare, analysis, stocks, news, result-feedback, screener, scans, strategies, saved-screens. Canonical list = exported V1_ENDPOINTS in index.ts. Auth resolves Clerk sub -> Mongo _id once; list endpoints support opt-in cursor pagination; X-Request-Id on every response. MONEY-1204 (P14) added six SUB-PATHS to the existing /v1/stocks family -- flags, delivery, derivatives, shareholding-pattern, insider-activity, deals -- all mounted via the mountStockSection helper and all returning the shared withProvenance envelope {data, source, asOf, empty, fallback?}. The family COUNT is unchanged by those.

api.convention: Whenever a server action with mobile relevance is added or changed in apps/web/lib/actions/, mirror it here. See feedback_api_sync.md.

content.purpose: Content authoring app for lessons, courses, quizzes, posts.

@usemoney/core.purpose: Heart of the product. Brokers, FIFO pairing, market data, screener, Gemini wrappers, calculations, currency, analytics, subscriptions, payments, imports.

@usemoney/services.purpose: Shared services. ONLY place that touches Prisma in product code. One service per domain.

@usemoney/research.purpose: StockSage autonomous financial research agent. Planner → executor → loop-controller.

@usemoney/validation.purpose: Zod schemas - chat-blocks, content, document, feedback, fire, holding, mutual-fund, paper, trade, common.

@usemoney/cache.purpose: 3-tier caching: L1 memory (10s) · L2 Redis (5min) · L3 SWR.

@usemoney/auth.purpose: Clerk wrappers. Maps Clerk userId → internal MongoDB User.

@usemoney/security.purpose: AES-256-GCM encryption (broker tokens), rate limiting (/rate-limit), cron-request auth (/cron-auth). Consolidated from apps/web/lib/security in MONEY-1062.

@usemoney/pubsub.purpose: Shared Google Cloud Pub/Sub client + 13 job publishers (client.ts + publish.ts). Extracted in MONEY-1062 by reconciling apps/web/lib/pubsub with the workers copy into ONE. Credentials via @usemoney/core/gemini/credentials; projectId pinned from GCP_PROJECT_ID. Consumed by apps/web + @usemoney/services.

@usemoney/storage.tip: Use { resumable: false, validation: false } when uploading from Cloud Run (see MEMORY.md project_financial_rag_pipeline).

@usemoney/datadog.caveat: APM only works where a Datadog Agent is reachable. Cloud Run uses a sidecar. Vercel: APM is OFF - use RUM/Logs/Metrics via HTTP API.

@usemoney/trpc.purpose: tRPC router definitions - shared between web and api.

@usemoney/utils.purpose: Generic helpers - be conservative when adding.

@usemoney/ui.purpose: Shared shadcn/ui primitives (accordion, alert, button, card, dialog, form, etc.).

workers.topology: Pub/Sub publishes → Hono route accepts push (OIDC verify) → dispatches to processor in workers/src/processors/<name>.ts
workers.topicNaming: <topic>-<env> where env is qa or prod (see workers/scripts/setup-pubsub.sh)

processors.etf-expense-enrichment: RETIRED (MONEY-1404). The processor is deleted; the route survives and answers 200 {retired:true}, same reason as financial-data-sync - Pub/Sub ACKs only on 2xx, so a 410 or a deleted route's 404 NACKs and burns five delivery attempts plus a dead-letter per message until setup-scheduler.sh prod removes the live weekly trigger. It could never write: fetchKuveraMetadata returns null unless MF_METADATA_PROVIDER === 'kuvera' and both specs set 'amfi'. expenseRatio now comes from AMFI's own monthly TER file via mf-metadata-sync.
processors.financial-data-sync: RETIRED (MONEY-1220). Its only source was Tickertape, which now 403s our Cloud Run egress. The route survives and answers 200 {retired:true} rather than 410/404, because Pub/Sub ACKs only on 2xx - any other status NACKs and burns five delivery attempts per message until the live scheduler is deleted.
processors.xbrl-sync: Archive NSE XBRL results filings -> XbrlFiling (23:15 IST daily, trailing 7-day window). The only leg with egress.
processors.xbrl-projection: Project archived filings -> StockFinancials, ANNUAL + QUARTERLY (23:45 IST daily). Writes only when XBRL_PROJECTION_APPLY=true.
processors.xbrl-ratios: Derive 23 of StockRatios' 25 columns from those filings + our own price history (22:00 IST Mon-Fri, after the 21:00 bhavcopy). targetPrice and recommendation are analyst opinion and are never written.
processors.alert-evaluator: Watchlist Alert evaluation on price ticks.

atlasSearch.fallback: atlas-search.ts has a 5-minute availability flag - after first SearchNotEnabled error it skips Atlas for that window.

groww.note: API key + SHA256, paid; no US.

chatOrchestrator.purpose: Receive chat messages → classify intent → dispatch (Flash response, navigate, or tool call) → emit ContentBlocks.

loop: planner.ts → produce plan of skills + tools
executor.ts → run tools, persist results to scratchpad
loop-controller.ts → decide whether to continue or finalize

analysisTiers.L4: Advanced 12-segment (8 credits, 60+ strategies, chart/candlestick patterns, macro)

wheresMyX.DB query / mutation: packages/services/src/<domain>.service.ts (NEVER from a component or action directly)

ops: Optional: add Cloud Scheduler job in scripts/ops/setup-scheduler.sh
newWorker.note: OIDC auth is required on the push route. Tracing is automatic via the Cloud Run sidecar.

newResearchTool.external: If pulling from a new source, add a wrapper in packages/research/src/data-sources/

newResearchSkill.planner: Add intent recognition to packages/research/src/planner.ts as needed

Process async via Pub/Sub if work is long-running

branchNaming.rule: {type}/MONEY-{number} only - NO text suffix. Examples: feat/MONEY-85, fix/MONEY-108.

buildAndType.yarnBuildOnSourceChange: Required before commit when source code changes. Next.js build catches type errors tsc --noEmit misses.
buildAndType.tscNoEmit: Insufficient on its own - does not catch webpack/Next.js client-bundle errors.

dataAccess.noDirectPrisma: Components, server actions, and API routes never touch Prisma. They call into @usemoney/services.
dataAccess.atlasSearch: Prod-only. Dual-path: Atlas in prod, regex in QA/dev (see project_screener_search_dual_path memory).
dataAccess.noFreshnessGates: Don't gate user-facing queries on lastSyncedAt/navDate. Trust upstream isActive; do cleanup in sync layer.

uiAndTheme.themeAware: Never hardcode dark RGBA. Use CSS vars or dark: prefix. Test both themes.
uiAndTheme.demoFlow: Try Demo CTA must survive landing/hero redesigns. Use window.location.href + tradebook_demo_mode localStorage flag.

ai.chatDegradesGracefully: Credit/quota walls return 200 + ErrorBlock + NavigationBlock upgrade CTA, not bare 403. Flash chat ungated for FREE.
ai.classifierCollapse: User-clickable surfaces use deterministic dispatch, not prompt fallthrough (avoids classifier collapse onto wrong tool).

ops.scriptsReadme: Any change in scripts/ (add/rename/remove/flag) requires same-PR README row update.
ops.testCoverageDoc: Any test add/remove/modify updates TEST-COVERAGE.md in the same PR.
ops.distClean: yarn dist-clean walks each dist/ and skips ones with git-tracked files (UDF bundle.js is tracked).
ops.chartingSync: postinstall is gated behind SYNC_CHARTING_LIBRARY=1. Bare yarn install must be a no-op for charting.

observability.datadogApm: Cloud Run only (sidecar). Vercel: DD_TRACE_ENABLED=false - use RUM + HTTP logs/metrics.

externalIntegrations.GoogleCloudStorage: Documents, learning content, RAG sources. Bucket stockbook-content-{env}.
externalIntegrations.GoogleCloudScheduler: Cron jobs (instrument sync, MF NAV, prices, bhavcopy, XBRL sync -> projection -> ratios, etc.). Retired jobs go in OLD_SCHEDULER_PREFIXES in scripts/ops/setup-scheduler.sh - deleting a definition only stops it being re-created, it does not take the live job down. NOTE the array name is misleading: delete_old_schedulers builds ${PREFIX}-${ENV} and deletes THAT EXACT NAME, so it is not a prefix match - a family of jobs needs every full name listed, or the unlisted ones keep firing forever (MONEY-1314). scheduler-retirement-contract.test.ts ratchets this: a name that leaves SCHEDULER_DEFS without appearing here fails the suite.
externalIntegrations.PostHog: Product analytics + feature flags. Project usemoney-web (272942).
externalIntegrations.BrokerApis: Zerodha (Kite), Upstox, Angel One (SmartAPI), Groww, Dhan, Fyers, HDFC Securities, ICICI Direct, Interactive Brokers.
externalIntegrations.DataProviders: Yahoo Finance, AMFI NAV feed, NSE/BSE, Screener.in (scrape), Chartink, RBI. Company financials and ratios are NOT bought or scraped - they are projected from our own archive of NSE XBRL filings. Tickertape was the financials source until MONEY-1220, when api.tickertape.in began returning 403 to our Cloud Run egress (200 from a laptop): a permanent, silent block, so it was removed from every scheduled path.

scripts.readme: scripts/README.md (must stay in sync with directory changes)

common.syncChart: yarn sync:chart (explicit - postinstall does NOT do this)

seedPipeline: instruments → MF → sectors → MF metadata → prices

knownGotchas.issue: Atlas Search throws SearchNotEnabled in non-prod environments.
knownGotchas.fix: atlas-search.ts uses an in-memory 5-minute availability flag - after first failure, skips Atlas. Dev/QA falls through to regex (services/discover.service.ts dual path).

knownGotchas.issue: Datadog APM (dd-trace) requires a local Datadog Agent on localhost:8126.
knownGotchas.fix: Cloud Run has a sidecar agent. Vercel does not - keep DD_TRACE_ENABLED=false there and rely on HTTP-based RUM/Logs/Metrics.

knownGotchas.issue: Workspace packages export raw .ts; bundling externals confuses tsup.
knownGotchas.fix: tsup config uses noExternal: [/@stockbook\/.*/] AND an esbuild onResolve plugin externalizing everything except @stockbook/*. See Docker/GCP build memory.

knownGotchas.issue: Prisma needs openssl on Alpine for correct engine binary detection.
knownGotchas.fix: Dockerfile installs openssl. COPY packages ./packages beats individual manifest copies.

knownGotchas.issue: GCS uploads from Cloud Run fail with resumable=true + validation=true.
knownGotchas.fix: Always upload with { resumable: false, validation: false }.

knownGotchas.issue: Chat classifier collapse - free-text prompts with shared vocab collapse to wrong tool.
knownGotchas.fix: User-clickable surfaces (buttons, tabs) use deterministic tool/navigate dispatch, not prompt fallthrough.

knownGotchas.issue: TradingView UDF bundle.js is git-tracked but lives in dist/.
knownGotchas.fix: yarn dist-clean walks each dist/ and skips directories with git-tracked files.

knownGotchas.issue: Screener data zeroed in dev when gated on lastSyncedAt/navDate.
knownGotchas.fix: Don't gate user-facing queries on freshness fields. Trust upstream isActive; do cleanup in sync layer.

knownGotchas.issue: Merged is not wired. MONEY-1115 shipped a complete, tested projection engine with no route, no topic, no scheduler and no job, so it wrote nothing for months while nothing errored.
knownGotchas.fix: A feature is wired only when you can name its entry point AND show observed data through it. Grep the topic constant in packages/types/src/pubsub.ts, the route mount in workers/src/index.ts, and the SCHEDULER_DEFS line in scripts/ops/setup-scheduler.sh - all three, not one.

knownGotchas.issue: A Cloud Run JOB pins its container image at provision time, so redeploying the SERVICE does not move it.
knownGotchas.fix: Re-run the job's setup script (e.g. scripts/ops/setup-xbrl-backfill-job.sh) after the image changes, or the job keeps executing the code it was created with.

agentTips: Read CLAUDE.md and this file BEFORE exploring. They tell you the conventions and where things live.
When you read MEMORY.md, paths like packages/core/src/brokers are claims about the codebase at a point in time - verify the file still exists if you intend to recommend an action on it.
Server actions (apps/web/lib/actions/*) are the canonical write path on web. Don't add Prisma calls anywhere else.
If you're tempted to add a util to packages/utils, check if a more specific package exists first.
Branch names MUST be {type}/MONEY-{number}. Husky and CI will reject anything else.
Never run git commit / push / yarn build / yarn install without the user asking, except where memory feedback rules explicitly permit it.
When making mobile-relevant changes, mirror server actions in apps/api/src/routes/v1.
Run yarn build before committing any source-code change in a bundle - tsc --noEmit alone misses Next.js client bundle errors.
